answer: DeepWalk reports an advantage when labeled data are sparse, i.e., in low-supervision / semi-supervised settings where only a small fraction of nodes have labels. In contrast, LINE states that it is designed to scale to very large graphs, emphasizing efficiency and scalability to graphs with billions of edges rather than specifically claiming an advantage under sparse labels.
